Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activities in assay CHEMBL4888487. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join, and filter by assay chembl_id. Keep only rows where standard_value is not null and standard_relation equals '='. Do not deduplicate. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
